page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-16-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance featuring 16 dedicated vCPUs and 62.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides approximately 3.88 GB of RAM per core, establishing a balanced resource distribution.

The instance includes a bundled local storage configuration consisting of one NVMe SSD with a capacity of 403 GB. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no integrated graphics processing units on this server type.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the inclusion of dedicated vCPUs and local NVMe storage provides high resource density for workloads requiring low-latency disk access without the overhead of network-attached storage. However, the lack of GPU acceleration and the fixed vCPU-to-RAM ratio limit its applicability for memory-intensive databases or machine learning training workloads.
This server configuration is designed for general-purpose workloads, web serving, containerized applications, and database nodes that benefit from fast local scratch space or caching layers.
